annotations.title: Crypto candles, OHLCV: open, high, low, close and volume of Hyperliquid perps

description: Historical price candles (OHLCV) of a Hyperliquid perpetual such as BTC, ETH or SOL: open, high, low, close, volume in coins and trade count per bar, newest last. Intervals 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w and more; up to 500 bars (default 50). Read from Hyperliquid's public API. Use for charts, backtests, volatility and trend checks, or as context for a trading agent. Example: coin=BTC. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
